messages:
From: Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@finbank.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: FinBank: Request for updated subprocessors and contingency details

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the steady cadence on the RFP. As we finish the vendor diligence pass on our side we need two items you promised in the security appendix:

1) An up-to-date list of all subprocessors used by Redwood for the hosted inference product (including cloud infra, caches/edge, analytics, and any managed SSO/KMS parties).
2) A brief contingency / fallback summary in case a subprocessor becomes unavailable (e.g., vendor exit or region deprecation).

Two specific items our legal team flagged: your edge cache partner (we show TailwindCloud listed previously) — please confirm current status and any migration timeline — and any imminent deprecations of cloud regions.

We appreciate an email reply with the roster and an attachment we can share with our procurement/compliance team. Ideally we also want the primary point-of-contact at the edge vendor for a direct SOC attestation.

Can you get this over by EOD next Tuesday? If helpful, schedule a quick 30-minute sync and loop in security.

Best,
Sandra
Sandra Lopez
Director, Vendor Risk — FinBank
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@finbank.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinBank: Request for updated subprocessors and contingency details

Sandra —

Thanks for the note. Attached is our current subprocessors roster and a change matrix that highlights any changes in the last 12 months. High-level summary below (will also attach a one-page PDF for your legal/compliance team):

- Core cloud providers: AWS (primary, us-west-2), GCP (secondary for failover).
- Storage & artifacts: AWS S3 (Redwood-managed), backups replicated to GCP region us-east1.
- KMS/HSM: CloudKMS (AWS KMS) with customer-managed key option for Private deployments; integrated HSM options available via our Private package.
- Edge caching / inference routing: TailwindCloud — currently active in production for low-latency prefix-KV caching.
- Observability and analytics: Internal Redwood telemetry + third-party telemetry pipeline hosted by LogStream Inc.
- Identity & SSO: Okta (enterprise) for RBAC and SAML.

Recent changes: FastEdge (third-party edge provider) was sunsetted in 2025-Q4; we completed an incremental migration to TailwindCloud and our internal fallback routing (GCP-hosted cache instances) is in place. See attached subprocessor_change_matrix_2026-02.csv for dates and contract references.

Contingency / fallback (summary):
- Automatic routing to alternative caching layer (GCP-hosted) within 3–10 minutes average for active sessions; cold-start implications up to 180s for very large KV-prefixes documented in the attached playbook.
- Model-serving fallback: automatic downgrade to a compatible 7B quantized variant hosted on Dedicated pools with guaranteed throughput (for customers with reserved capacity).
- Regional failover: requests can route to eu-west-1 or us-east-1 with data residency controls; we will not replicate customer plaintext prompts to outside regions unless explicitly permitted in the customer config.

Attached: redwood_subprocessors_2026-02.pdf, subprocessor_change_matrix_2026-02.csv. I also attached a copy of TailwindCloud's latest SOC2 report they provided on onboarding (tailwind_soc2_cert_copy.pdf).

If you want, I'll set up a call with Rishi (our security lead) and Tailwind contact to go through attestation details.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0164

Attachments: redwood_subprocessors_2026-02.pdf (roster, vendor descriptions), subprocessor_change_matrix_2026-02.csv (change log), tailwind_soc2_cert_copy.pdf
From: Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@finbank.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: vendor-compliance@finbank.com
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinBank: Request for updated subprocessors and contingency details

Lauren —

Appreciate the quick summary and attachments. A few follow-ups from our compliance reviewers after an initial scan:

- Can you confirm the effective date of the TailwindCloud SOC2 report included? Our policy requires reports no older than 12 months.
- We need contact details for Tailwind's compliance/security point of contact to request their security questionnaire. Your attachment lists only a general ops email.
- Does Redwood offer an on-prem/private deployment option that keeps inference execution strictly inside our VPC (no caching or routing to third parties)? If so, what’s the expected lead time and additional contract language (we may require a subprocessor addendum).

Also we noticed the migration from FastEdge — can you point to a specific change notice you issued to customers when that happened? We need to verify customer notification timing.

Would prefer answers in writing; we can schedule a short follow-up call if needed.

Thanks,
Sandra
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@finbank.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinBank: Request for updated subprocessors and contingency details

Hi Sandra — looping in answers below and linking the artifacts we use for attestations. Forwarding Tailwind's compliance contact at the bottom.

1) Tailwind SOC2 effective date: 2025-11-12 (report issued Nov 12, 2025). Copy attached as tailwind_soc2_cert_copy.pdf; we re-request annually and will provide the updated report as soon as it's available.

2) Tailwind compliance contact: edgeops@tailwindcloud.net (we have an existing NDAs/processor contract). If you want, I can introduce you directly; they have a compliance packet and will accept a written questionnaire.

3) On-prem / Private option: yes—Redwood Private supports a VPC-only deployment with optional on-prem packaging. Summary:
- Lead time: typical onboarding 6–10 weeks (enterprise entitlements + network config), accelerated options possible with an SOW.
- Behavior: with Private + no third-party caching configured, inference execution stays inside customer's VPC; optional KMS integration ensures keys never leave your control.
- Contracting: we provide a subprocessor addendum and can sign a limited subprocessor waiver for the set of subprocessors you specifically disallow.

4) FastEdge migration notice: we published a customer change notice on 2025-10-08 (email + console banner). The related entry and copy of the notice are in the shared drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/FinBank/subprocessors/2026-02-roster (folder contains the notice and dated archive).

5) Playbook & fallbacks (short):
- Active session cache failover: internal routing triggers within ~5 minutes; we post an incident timeline and remediation steps to the Console incident page.
- Manual escalation: for Tier-1 customers we can initiate Dedicated pool allocation and prioritized warmup to minimize impact (<60m to restore equivalent latency for most workloads).

Related links / artifacts for your team: 
- Roster & change log: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/FinBank/subprocessors/2026-02-roster
- Subprocessor addendum (template / docusign): https://docusign.com/drive/ABC-Addendum-2026

If you want a live walkthrough I can introduce Tailwind and set a 30-minute call this week.

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Trust — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
